description: Find and verify a work email for people through a cost-aware waterfall: Apollo match -> Hunter finder -> optional Hunter verifier -> free local checks (syntax, MX, disposable, role). Paid tiers stop when the budget runs out. Returns each person with an email status, confidence, and a `trail` of what was tried and what it cost. Provide 1-25 people, each identified by prospect_id, apollo_id, linkedin_url, an email, or first_name + last_name + domain. Does NOT send email or reveal phones.
name: sdr_waterfall_enrich_person
title: Waterfall enrich person
